text: This discipline was established and rapidly developed in the early and middle periods of the 20th century. It is mainly composed of specialties such as aircraft design, propulsion theory and engineering, manufacturing engineering, human-machine and environmental engineering, etc., and it also intersects and permeates with multiple disciplines such as mathematics, mechanics, chemistry, power engineering and engineering thermophysics, and materials science and engineering.The development of aerospace technology has had a significant impact on numerous sectors of the national economy and many aspects of social life. It not only provides new means for transportation, communication and broadcasting, but also promotes the development of scientific research, and at the same time brings fundamental changes in the military field. The development level of aerospace science and aerospace industry is a reflection of a country's comprehensive national strength.
